knownIssues: Insert Component and Insert Derive read only this app's JSON design files: the app has STEP export but no STEP import.

Fasteners: shanks are plain (no modeled or cosmetic threads); library is ISO M3..M20 and ANSI #10..3/4; auto size takes the largest nominal size not larger than the hole, so a tapped (tap-drill) hole gets the next smaller size.
Fastener Stack Analysis is a results dialog, not a persistent entry in the browser Analysis folder.

Decal is a viewport overlay (planar projection in the decal frame): it does not follow component display transforms during joint animation until the next recompute, and Chain Faces covers front-facing faces of the same body inside the decal rectangle.
Arrange packs bounding-box footprints in shelves (no true-shape nesting, 0 or 90 degree turns); a sketch profile envelope uses the profile's bounding rectangle.
Find Similar Components compares only inside the open design (no hub search, by design of the task).
